QuestInfo.name: Reporting to Neinheart
QuestInfo.0: 10 Boogies looks satisfied with the permit. Now might be a good time to ask about your next mission.
QuestInfo.1:
You must report to Neinheart that the first mission has been completed.

Press the hotkey Q to open the quest info window and then click on the Navigation button. You can follow the red arrow over your head to meet Neinheart.
QuestInfo.2: You have reported your success to Neinheart.

0.0: Uh, if you need more work, I guess go back to Neinheart and tell him how great we did. I've got other stuff to do.
0.1: I'll send you to where Neinheart is. \rThank you so much for everything. I hope to see you again!\r\n\r\n#e(You will be moved to Neinheart's location after you accept.)#n

no.0: I've gotta get back to Ereve with this permit. Are you scared of Neinheart or something?

1.0: Did you finish the first mission? 10 Boogies was not my first choice for a mentor, but you seem mostly unscathed.

yes.0: Your next mission may be a bit advanced, but you're all I have available at the moment.

npc.0: Tell Neinheart how awesome we did on that mission! You can find him on the World Map if you need to.
